cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I texted that I'd lost my job. You replied, 'What's for dinner?'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought something normal would help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Making your dinner? Can you see why I felt like the cook?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant we could go out. I'll book somewhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believe you. Before you book, can you see why I heard a chore? I needed you to ask how I was.

mechanism: A applies its old listening instruction to correct a partner interpretation of why its dinner reply hurt after job loss.
confusable: Not demanding a better dinner: A distinguishes repair offers from acknowledging the emotional meaning of the first response.
comparison: Absence of witness versus misread domestic expectation.
seedUse: D99 job loss/dinner/chore/booking; S05 taught listening sequence drives acknowledgment.
